chosen:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
trap 'echo "An error occurred in $0 at line $LINENO" >&2' ERR
trap 'echo "Exiting $0 with status $?"' EXIT

SERVICE_NAME="my-service"
CONFIG_FILE="/etc/my-service/config.conf"
SERVICE_CHECK_CMD="systemctl is-active --quiet $SERVICE_NAME"

if ! $SERVICE_CHECK_CMD; then
    echo "Service $SERVICE_NAME is not running, attempting to restart it."
    systemctl restart "$SERVICE_NAME"
    if ! $SERVICE_CHECK_CMD; then
        echo "Failed to restart $SERVICE_NAME" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Service $SERVICE_NAME has been successfully restarted."
fi

if [[ ! -r "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Configuration file $CONFIG_FILE is not readable." >&2
    exit 1
fi
echo "Service $SERVICE_NAME is running and configuration file is readable."
```
### Explanation
This script checks if the specified service is running and restarts it if necessary. It also verifies the existence and readability of a critical configuration file. The script uses `set -euo pipefail` to ensure that any failure in the pipeline will result in an error and exit. Error traps are set to log the line number and error message when an error occurs, and the script exits with a descriptive message if the service fails to restart or the configuration file is unreadable.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
trap 'echo "An error occurred in $0 at line $LINENO" >&2' ERR
trap 'echo "Exiting $0 with status $?"' EXIT

REMOTE_FILE_URL="http://example.com/file.tar.gz"
LOCAL_FILE="/tmp/file.tar.gz"
CHECKSUM_URL="http://example.com/file.tar.gz.sha256"
LOCAL_CHECKSUM="/tmp/file.sha256"

retry_download() {
    local attempts=3
    while [[ $attempts -gt 0 ]]; do
        curl -L -o "$LOCAL_FILE" "$REMOTE_FILE_URL"
        curl -L -o "$LOCAL_CHECKSUM" "$CHECKSUM_URL"
        if [[ $(sha256sum -c "$LOCAL_CHECKSUM" --status) -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "Checksum verified, download successful."
            return 0
        fi
        echo "Checksum verification failed, retrying download..."
        rm "$LOCAL_FILE" "$LOCAL_CHECKSUM"
        ((attempts--))
    done
    echo "Failed to download and verify checksum after retries." >&2
    exit 1
}

retry_download
```

```bash
    if systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE"; then

        exit 1
    fi
}

log "Starting service check for $SERVICE."
check_service_status
check_service_version
```

```bash
}
```
